title: SheetAlign: Grounded Interaction and Stage-Isolated Learning for Spreadsheet Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.26069v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spreadsheets are widely used for data analysis and supporting decision-making. Automating spreadsheet analysis while protecting sensitive data and controlling deployment costs motivates locally deployed open-weight large language models (LLMs). Meanwhile, complex spreadsheet tasks require both task reasoning and workbook understanding, while predefined operation interfaces impose additional tool-selection and invocation demands. We introduce SheetAlign, a spreadsheet manipulation framework with stage-isolated policy learning, organized around where to operate, what to change, and how to implement transformations. Task-guided inspection and API grounding anchor code generation in workbook observations and available operations, while stage-isolated learning optimizes program generation and review using edit-progress rewards. At inference, execution consistency selects programs through agreement among workbook states. On SpreadsheetBench, o

translated_title: SheetAlign：面向电子表格智能体的具接地交互与阶段隔离学习
translated_abstract: 电子表格被广泛用于数据分析和决策支持。在保护敏感数据和控制部署成本的前提下实现电子表格分析自动化，推动了本地部署的开源权重大语言模型（LLM）的应用。同时，复杂的电子表格任务既需要任务推理，也需要对工作簿的理解，而预定义的操作接口还带来了额外的工具选择与调用需求。我们提出了SheetAlign，一个具有阶段隔离策略学习的电子表格操作框架，围绕“在哪里操作、更改什么、以及如何实现转换”来组织。任务引导的检查和API接地将代码生成锚定在工作簿观察和可用操作上，而阶段隔离学习则利用编辑进度奖励来优化程序生成与审查。在推理阶段，执行一致性通过工作簿状态之间的一致性来选择程序。在SpreadsheetBench上...
tldr: SheetAlign是一个电子表格操作框架，通过阶段隔离策略学习、任务引导的API接地以及基于执行一致性的程序选择，将代码生成锚定在工作簿观察与可用操作上，从而在SpreadsheetBench上取得优异表现。
en_tdlr: SheetAlign is a spreadsheet manipulation framework that anchors code generation in workbook observations and available operations through stage-isolated policy learning, task-guided API grounding, and execution-consistency-based program selection, achieving strong performance on SpreadsheetBench.
